title: Same Problem, Different Answer: reproducibility artifacts
description:
Code, per-item predictions, raw LLM responses, analysis outputs, and SHA256 provenance for the paper "Same Problem, Different Answer: Accuracy Hides Cross-Lingual Inconsistency in Multilingual Inference" (LUHME 2026 workshop at EMNLP 2026). The artifact measures item-level cross-lingual consistency of multilingual natural language inference on the parallel XNLI test set (5,010 items in 15 languages) for two open-weight models and three hosted LLMs, and regenerates every reported number from the committed outputs.
